item.name: Docusign Retrieves the user profile for a specified user.

request.name: Docusign Retrieves the user profile for a specified user.

description.content:
Retrieves the user profile information, the privacy settings and personal information (address, phone number, etc.) for the specified user.

The userId parameter specified in the endpoint must match the authenticated user's user ID and the user must be a member of the specified account.

variable.description: (Required) The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

(Required) The user ID of the user being accessed. Generally this is the user ID of the authenticated user, but if the authenticated user is an Admin on the account, this may be another user the Admin user is accessing. **Note**: For the [GET /v2/accounts/{accountId}/envelopes](https://developers.docusign.com/esign-rest-api/reference/Envelopes/Envelopes/listStatusChanges/#envelopesInformation) method, the `user_id` query parameter is not implemented and should not be used.

response.name: Successful response.

item.name: Docusign Updates the user profile information for the specified user.

request.name: Docusign Updates the user profile information for the specified user.

description.content:
Updates the user's detail information, profile information, privacy settings, and personal information in the user ID card.

You can also change a user's name by changing the information in the `userDetails` property. When changing a user's name, you can either change the information in the `userName` property OR change the information in `firstName`, `middleName`, `lastName, suffixName`, and `title` properties. Changes to `firstName`, `middleName`, `lastName`, `suffixName`, and `title` properties take precedence over changes to the `userName` property.

variable.description: (Required) The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

(Required) The user ID of the user being accessed. variable.description: (Required) The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

(Required) The user ID of the user being accessed. Generally this is the user ID of the authenticated user, but if the authenticated user is an Admin on the account, this may be another user the Admin user is accessing. **Note**: For the [GET /v2/accounts/{accountId}/envelopes](https://developers.docusign.com/esign-rest-api/reference/Envelopes/Envelopes/listStatusChanges/#envelopesInformation) method, the `user_id` query parameter is not implemented and should not be used.
